age.evidence: Eight academy players (Acd; 18 ± 1 years) in their third week of preseason with no reported incidence of concussion from the previous 6 months, eight Professional rugby players with 10+ years professional rugby experience (Pro; 33 ± 5 years) in the first week of preseason with no concussions reported for the last 6 months and eight CrossFit athletes (Xfit; 32 ± 5 years) age matched to the Pro group and no history of concussion or other high grade impact injuries, were recruited for blood sampling (Figure 1).
